keyframe_review.note: New keyframe. The Alash Autonomy was 'largely unrecognized' (SEM) and its land was in Balabanov's de facto hands until 1919 (AA); the shape is the claim, drawn soft. The pages give no area and no oblasts. The shape is Kazakhstan minus the Qyzylorda, South Kazakhstan, Zhambyl and Almaty admin-1s (about 584,000 km2, 2,308 gazetteer cells): AA puts 'the Turkestan Autonomy to the south', and russian-turkestan (to 1918/4) and turkestan-assr (1918-1924) hold those four admin-1s (the Syr-Darya and Semirechye oblasts) in the same years, so they are not drawn twice; no page opened (AA, AP, KZ, SEM, and the Alash_Orda page, which repeats AA's borders sentence) shows Alash holding or disputing a district there, so no contest is recorded. The remainder is about 1.7 M km2 of the 2.3 M km2 gazetteer total for Kazakhstan; it still understates the claim in Russia (Orenburg, Omsk) and Uzbekistan (Karakalpakia) that the Kirghiz ASSR later held (KZ).

sources.note: Opened for the review: repeats 'bordered Russian territories to the north and west, the Turkestan Autonomy to the south'; the provisional government 13 September 1917 to 1918; 'By 1920, the Bolsheviks ... occupied Kazakhstan'; Kirghiz ASSR 17 August 1920. No oblast list, no Western Alash Orda, Uralsk or Zhympity.

notes: Written for batch ia-03-x from four pages (AA, AP, KZ, SEM; budget 2-5). Unsettled: no page names the oblasts claimed (AA gives only the bordering lands); Kazakhstan is the researcher's shape. AA's body gives 13 September 1917 for the Alash Orda government and 5-13 December 1917 for the congress; AP says the party was founded in December 1917 and held an all-Kazakh congress at Orenburg on 21-28 July 1917. Review fix (2026-10-19): the shape is Kazakhstan minus the Qyzylorda, South Kazakhstan, Zhambyl and Almaty admin-1s, because the Syr-Darya and Semirechye oblasts belonged to russian-turkestan and turkestan-assr in the same years and AA names the Turkestan Autonomy to the south; the claim still overlaps Russia's Orenburg and Omsk lands, so the renderer should draw it soft and under the other states. Western Alash Orda (Uralsk, Zhympity) and the oblast list are not on any opened page (AA, AP, KZ, SEM, and the Alash_Orda page, which repeats AA's borders sentence); the 1919 Soviet takeover is dated only 'by 1919' (AA) and 'by 1920' (Alash_Orda), so it is not a ledger event.
